correctness.rationale: A residue-field simultaneous primitive pair a,f_eps(a) with p>=7 has nonzero derivative d=1-eps a^-2 since a has multiplicative order p-1>4. For x=A+pt modulo p^2 the two Fermat quotients each vanish at exactly one linear t; the union forbids 2-delta of p first lifts. The ordinary p^2 primitive-root criterion and p-adic lifting give p^(k-2)(p-2+delta) for all k>=2. Cohen et al Corollary 2 supplies the finite-field exceptional primes, direct small-prime checks eliminate the candidates. Independent modular enumeration for 89 seed/sign prime-square fibers agreed; finite enumeration does not prove all p,k. Distinguishes Z/p^kZ from F_{p^k}.

originality.rationale: Sun Conjecture 4.10 is precisely prime-POWER RING existence, not finite-field primitive elements in F_{p^k}. Cohen et al Corollary 2 resolves seed availability over F_p; the nonzero derivative plus two explicit Fermat-quotient exclusion counts yield the missing ring lift. Carella addresses simultaneous primitive roots across moduli levels of the same integer rather than reciprocal Laurent pair constraints. No identified stronger published ring-pair theorem covers the local count or both conjecture signs.
